name: Netuoso Animator
description: Keyframe animation tool: record object motion in the editor and compile it into Move/Rotate/Scale triggers.

pos-multiplier.name: Move units multiplier
pos-multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to editor-unit deltas when writing Move trigger offsets. 1.0 = raw editor units (30 units = 1 block). Set 0.333 if generated moves travel 3x too far.
